description: Test suite for the 'recap' feature in the Mattermost server, including creating, retrieving, and processing recaps and recap channels.

classes.name: model.Recap
classes.description: Represents a recap entity with metadata such as user ID, title, timestamps, status, and message count.

classes.name: model.RecapChannel
classes.description: Represents a channel associated with a recap, including channel details and related post IDs.

classes.name: model.Session
classes.description: Represents a user session with a user ID.

methods.name: TestCreateRecap
methods.description: Tests creating recaps with valid channels and permission checks.

methods.name: TestGetRecap
methods.description: Tests retrieving recaps by owner and non-owner.

methods.name: TestGetRecapsForUser
methods.description: Tests fetching multiple recaps for a user with pagination.

methods.name: TestMarkRecapAsRead
methods.description: Tests marking a recap as read by owner and non-owner.

methods.name: TestProcessRecapChannel
methods.description: Tests processing a recap channel with no posts and with posts.

methods.name: TestExtractPostIDs
methods.description: Tests extracting post IDs from a list of posts and from an empty list.
